head: 809627bfa0deb8c1b1393f731bf3cb9a3c21ee66
title: feat(research): recoverable PDF workflow and current-source citations
body:
## Summary

Add a recoverable local PDF reading and drafting workflow with current-source citations.

- Ingest selectable-text PDFs into a local `.work/**` workspace without copying the original PDF.
- Inspect workspace readiness, select papers, prepare or resume model tasks, and export cited QA or writing Markdown through the research CLI and reading Skill.
- Publish PDF and session state atomically, refusing stale or forged evidence with `INDEX_STALE` and preserving unrelated outputs across retries.
- Document Bash and zsh safe CLI-array flows, including source-tree and installed-wheel usage.

The R5 delivery follows the previous R4 delivery `ca63bdeb283dd3182db458d784909fed4c98bec5` and is committed at `809627bfa0deb8c1b1393f731bf3cb9a3c21ee66`. It changes only `tests/research/test_light_workflow_installed.py` plus release evidence. The installed-wheel fixture now copies the locked `typing-extensions` dependency when running below Python 3.13, matching the lockfile marker that caused both R4 Python 3.12 CI jobs to fail. Production code, assertions, dependency pins, schemas, and catalog data remain unchanged; the R4 CI failure record is preserved in the R5 evidence.

## Validation

- Locked Python 3.12.14 full suite: **2382 passed, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped**.
- Targeted installed-wheel workflow check on locked Python 3.13.13: **1 passed**.
- Native module and console workflow checks passed under both locked Python versions outside the source checkout.
- Reused offline wheel SHA-256: `3b3f08e1e903b1abdfd21a9b141b557ffa237753670739b0e70877044aa08522`; all 109 packaged Python modules and all 53 schemas match the candidate.
- The catalog remains at 67 entries; dependency and schema bytes are unchanged.
- The current-session real-PDF trial produced cited QA and writing outputs with four valid links and eight verified evidence rows each; invalid citations were refused without output. Bash and zsh documented flows passed.
- Fresh Tests run `34151119751` attempt 1 passed all four Linux/macOS × Python 3.12/3.13 jobs, with **2382 passed** in each job, against merge checkout `08f7dda118477f929bbaea2748d127b591a4f986`. Its ordered parents are `08709894adfb20ec07e976783f0ba436d975b74f` and `809627bfa0deb8c1b1393f731bf3cb9a3c21ee66`.
- These real-PDF and model-trial results are engineering evidence. Human factual, visual, provenance, backup, and readiness gates remain open.

## Delivery status

- Draft PR targeting `integration`; exact delivered commit: `809627bfa0deb8c1b1393f731bf3cb9a3c21ee66`.
- Fresh Tests run `34151119751` attempt 1 is green at exact head `809627bfa0deb8c1b1393f731bf3cb9a3c21ee66` and merge checkout `08f7dda118477f929bbaea2748d127b591a4f986`; all four jobs passed 2382 tests. Architect accepted the exact head after CI; the separate post-CI acceptance and verification records remain local evidence and are not carried in this commit.
- No automatic merge or human-gate closure is requested; human factual, visual, provenance, backup, and readiness gates remain open.
